dns_failure.title: DNS resolution failure
actions: Check resolver reachability and query the monitored record from the affected location.
Compare DNS answers and resolver errors across locations.

connection_failure.description: Measured connection refusals or unreachable routes
connection_failure.title: Connection failure
actions: Verify the target listener, routes and firewall from the affected location.
Compare connectivity from an independent location.

tls_problem.description: Measured TLS handshake or certificate validity errors
tls_problem.title: TLS or certificate problem
actions: Inspect the served certificate chain, expiry and hostname match.
Verify TLS negotiation from the affected location.

protocol_error.description: Measured application or protocol status and assertion failures
protocol_error.title: Application or protocol error
actions: Inspect application logs around the first failing check.
Verify the expected protocol response and recent releases.

latency_degradation.description: Measured latency increase against healthy checks in this window
latency_degradation.title: Latency degradation
actions: Compare DNS, connection, TLS and first-byte timings with the healthy baseline.
Inspect application latency and traffic around the failure window.

resource_pressure.description: Fresh monitored host metrics show high CPU or memory utilization during failures
resource_pressure.title: Monitored resource pressure
actions: Inspect CPU and memory utilization on the monitored host during the failure window.
Check workload saturation and capacity before changing limits.

upstream_failure.description: Configured upstream has measured failures before dependent failures
upstream_failure.title: Configured upstream failure
actions: Inspect the configured upstream's first failing checks.
Restore upstream health and verify dependent recovery.

maintenance_downtime.description: A maintenance window overlaps measured downtime
maintenance_downtime.title: Maintenance-associated downtime
actions: Confirm the maintenance owner expected this downtime.
Verify recovery after the maintenance window ends.

insufficient_evidence.description: Missing, conflicting, unsupported or inconclusive evidence
insufficient_evidence.title: Insufficient evidence
actions: Review the linked monitor transitions and collect missing telemetry.
Compare failures across locations and configured upstreams before assigning a cause.

a_depends_b.description: Repeated B-before-A failures with corroborating service evidence support a suspected B upstream of A

b_depends_a.description: Repeated A-before-B failures with corroborating service evidence support a suspected A upstream of B

shared_upstream.description: Known common upstream evidence explains both failures

no_dependency.description: Independent failures or healthy counterpart evidence

insufficient_evidence.description: Correlation, names alone, conflicting direction or missing history cannot establish a dependency
